# Sleep Bar Chart

A simple offline browser app for tracking hours slept per day.

## Features

- Input fields for each day of the week (0–12 hours)
- Bar chart drawn on canvas, with the longest night highlighted
- Weekly average displayed to one decimal place
- Responsive layout, keyboard accessible

## How to use

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Adjust the input values to see the chart and average update instantly.

No dependencies, no network requests.
